dashboard.title: CSV Extra Batch - Flujos por Dataset

targets.rawSql: WITH types(batch_type) AS (VALUES ('results'), ('fixtures'), ('match-summary'), ('team-stats'), ('stats-player'), ('point-by-point'), ('match-details'), ('h2h'), ('odds')), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (batch_type) batch_type, status, created_at, finished_at, attempts, error FROM public.batch_launch_request ORDER BY batch_type, created_at DESC) SELECT types.batch_type AS "Flujo", COALESCE(latest.status, 'SIN EJECUCIONES') AS "Estado", latest.created_at AS "Último envío", latest.finished_at AS "Fin", latest.attempts AS "Intentos", latest.error AS "Error" FROM types LEFT JOIN latest USING (batch_type) ORDER BY 1
SELECT batch_type AS flujo, count(*) AS completados FROM public.batch_launch_request WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY batch_type ORDER BY completados DESC

SELECT finished_at AS time, batch_type AS metric, extract(epoch FROM (finished_at - started_at)) AS value FROM public.batch_launch_request WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) ORDER BY 1
